name: The Freshman: Game of Love
source:
The university is holding a Valentine's Day competition to crown the cutest couple on campus! Will you and your partner be able to work together to show your worth?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Freshman:_Game_of_Love]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
大学正在举办情人节比赛，评选出校园里最可爱的情侣！你和你的伴侣能够一起努力展现你们的价值吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Freshman:_Game_of_Love]Choices Wikia[/url]]
